userStories.story: Initialize Love2D project structure with main.lua and basic map rendering.
Implement player character with physics-based movement (run, jump, collision).
Create a tilemap system that supports digging (removing tiles) and adding them to inventory.
Implement building mechanics to place tiles from inventory into the world.
Add Base entities for Team Left and Team Right with health properties.
Implement resource generation with higher value ores in the map center.
Implement base upgrade system consuming collected resources.
Create basic AI opponent that can move and interact with the world.
Create a main menu UI with Play, Settings, and Quit buttons using Love2D's built-in drawing functions.
